title: Gold Rate Today November 16: Check latest Gold prices in Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune & Other Cities - The HinduBusinessLine

Gold prices in India today were ₹12,620 for 1 gram of 22-carat gold (down by ₹75) and ₹1,00,960 for 8 grams of 22-carat gold (down by ₹600). | Photo Credit: REUTERS/FRANCIS MASCARENHAS
